Keywords: engagement rate likes comments shares interaction per follower performance
What It Measures: Percentage of followers (or reached accounts) who interact with a post. Primary health metric of content quality.
Good Benchmark: Instagram: 3-6% (by followers), 1-2% by reach. LinkedIn: 2-5%. TikTok: 4-8%. Facebook page: 0.5-1%.
How to Improve: Improve hook to stop scroll. Ask better questions in CTA. Post at optimal times. Use more relatable/emotional content.
Tool: Instagram Insights, LinkedIn Analytics, TikTok Analytics, Sprout Social, Hootsuite

Keywords: reach unique accounts impressions organic paid non-followers discovered
What It Measures: How many unique accounts saw your content. Reach = unique people. Impressions = total views (one person can contribute multiple impressions).
Good Benchmark: Varies. Growing accounts aim for reach > 20% of follower count per post. Viral: 5-10x follower count reach.
How to Improve: Use Reels/TikTok (highest organic reach format). Use trending audio. Post at peak times. Engage with commenters immediately after posting.
Tool: Instagram Insights (reach breakdown: home, explore, hashtag), TikTok Analytics

Keywords: saves bookmark save rate quality content educational value reference
What It Measures: Number of users who saved your post for later reference. Instagram's strongest positive signal to the algorithm.
Good Benchmark: Instagram: aim 1-3% of reach as saves for educational content. Above 5% is excellent.
How to Improve: Create reference-worthy content: step-by-step guides, numbered lists, templates, checklists, frameworks. Add 'Save this for later' CTA explicitly.

Keywords: shares reposts retweets viral distribution word of mouth organic spread
What It Measures: How many users shared your content to their network. The most powerful amplification signal.
Good Benchmark: Varies widely. Viral posts achieve shares = 5-10% of reach. Good posts: 0.5-2% share rate.
How to Improve: Create 'I need to share this' content: relatable observations, controversial but agreeable takes, surprising data, 'tag a friend who...' posts, useful tools.
Tool: Instagram Insights, Twitter/X Analytics, LinkedIn Analytics, TikTok Analytics

Keywords: ctr click through rate ad performance link click percentage impressions
What It Measures: Percentage of people who saw your content/ad and clicked the link. Measures content relevance and CTA strength.
Good Benchmark: Ads — Facebook/Instagram: 1-3% good, 3%+ excellent. Google Search ads: 3-8% good. Organic posts: 0.5-1.5% typical.
How to Improve: Improve hook and CTA copy. Match ad creative to landing page (message match). Use benefit-focused CTAs ('Get the free guide' > 'Click here'). Test different visual formats.
Tool: Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager

Keywords: watch time video completion rate retention audience hold audience interest
What It Measures: What percentage of the video the average viewer watches. The #1 signal on TikTok and YouTube for algorithmic amplification.
Good Benchmark: TikTok: aim 50%+ completion rate. YouTube: 40-60% average view duration is good. Reels: 80%+ is excellent for short clips.
How to Improve: Hook in first 3 seconds. Cut unnecessary intros. Use pattern interrupts (new visual, sound, graphic every 5-7 seconds). Add 'Stay to the end for X' teasers.
Tool: TikTok Analytics (avg watch time), YouTube Studio (audience retention), Instagram Insights (avg play time)

Keywords: follower growth rate new followers gained percent change audience building momentum
What It Measures: How fast your following is growing as a percentage of current size. Signals content quality and discoverability.
Good Benchmark: Healthy: 1-3%/month. Strong: 5-10%/month. Viral phase: 20-50%+ in a week.
How to Improve: Optimize profile (bio + profile photo + pinned post). Post consistently. Use Reels/TikTok for new audience discovery. Collaborate with similar-size creators.
Tool: All platform native analytics + Social Blade for public tracking

Keywords: cost per lead cpl facebook ads linkedin ads google ads lead generation ads efficiency
What It Measures: How much you're paying (in ad spend) for each new lead. Primary efficiency metric for paid lead gen campaigns.
Good Benchmark: CPL benchmarks by platform: Facebook Lead Ads: $10-50 (consumer), $30-150 (B2B). LinkedIn: $50-200. Google: $20-100 (varies by industry heavily).
How to Improve: Improve targeting (warm audiences cost less). Test different offers (free tools/guides outperform generic 'contact us'). Optimize landing page conversion rate.
Tool: Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, HubSpot

Keywords: roas return on ad spend revenue per dollar spent conversion value efficiency ecommerce
What It Measures: Revenue generated per dollar spent on advertising. Primary efficiency metric for e-commerce ad campaigns.
Good Benchmark: Minimum: 1x (breaking even). Good: 2-3x. Excellent: 4-6x. Varies by margin — high-margin products can be profitable at 2x, low-margin need 5x+.
How to Improve: Improve landing page conversion rate. Test different creative (UGC vs produced). Refine targeting to highest-intent audiences. Implement abandoned cart email follow-up.
Tool: Meta Ads Manager (Revenue column), Google Ads (Conv. value/cost), Triple Whale, Northbeam

Keywords: email open rate inbox subject line performance list health deliverability
What It Measures: Percentage of recipients who opened your email. Primary email health metric (though iOS privacy impacted accuracy post-2021).
Good Benchmark: Good: 25-35%. Excellent: 40%+. Below 15% indicates deliverability or subject line issues. B2B tends higher than B2C.
How to Improve: Improve subject lines (A/B test). Send at optimal times (Tuesday-Thursday 10am). Clean list (remove bounces + 6-month inactives). Segment (targeted emails get 50% higher opens).

Keywords: profile visits bio click instagram linkedin conversion profile to follow
What It Measures: How many people clicked to view your profile after seeing a post. Signals interest in you beyond the individual post.
Good Benchmark: Good Reels: 1-5% of reaches visit profile. Viral post: 10-30% profile visit rate.
How to Improve: Include a profile hook in your content (mention what you do, who you help). Controversial/bold posts drive more profile curiosity. Optimize profile before pushing reach.
Tool: Instagram Insights (per-post profile visits), LinkedIn Profile analytics
